In today's episode, we sit down with Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, to understand how he thinks, makes decisions, and bets on ideas before the world believes in them.
The conversation also covers why India is OpenAI's biggest market, how he avoids yes-men, and the two ways AI could go wrong. He shares what he looks for in founders, why ambition can be taught, why this is the best time in history to build, and how AI could help discover new science.
